description: This file defines a simple method named 'convertUomProduct' used for unit of measure (UoM) conversions based on product attributes within the OFBiz framework. It includes logic for handling different UoM types and performing conversions considering product dimensions and weight.

methods.name: convertUomProduct
methods.description: Performs unit of measure conversion for a product, considering its dimensions, weight, and the specified UoMs, with detailed logging and error handling.
